class.name: arx_ros2_control/ArxX5Hardware
class.description: ARX X5 / AC One hardware interface (Stanford arx5-sdk). One SystemInterface per arm (dual AC One: left + right instances). Always exports position/velocity/effort/kp/kd; control_mode selects write(): full_control (OCS2 MIX, default) | position (legacy real pos + HI gains) | pd_control (HT-compatible alias of position). Same contract as panthera-ht.
